parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry is_test=true — `iTunesArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession` in `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift` and `MetadataMockWebSession` in `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/PlaycutMetadataServiceCachingTests.swift`. Per the decision rules, any cluster where even one record is a test fixture warrants no-action; here both are test-only types. Additionally, the two types differ in a semantically meaningful way — `responses:[Data]` vs `responses:[String: Data]` — indicating they model distinct stubbing strategies (sequential vs keyed-by-URL), so their structural similarity is partly coincidental and extracting a shared PAT would couple unrelated test packages without meaningful benefit.
